description: This file defines the SNMigrationService class, which orchestrates and manages multi-stage migrations within the application. It handles migration registration, execution, version checking, and application state transitions, inheriting from an abstract service base. The class interacts with various other migration-related classes, version comparison utilities, and application lifecycle events.

classes.name: SNMigrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for orchestrating multi-stage migrations during application lifecycle events, handling version upgrades, migration execution, and integration with application state and events.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and resets internal state when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the migration service by executing pre-run steps, determining required migrations based on stored version, and setting up migration instances.

methods.name: markMigrationsAsDone
methods.description: Marks migrations as completed by updating the stored version in persistent storage.

methods.name: runBaseMigrationPreRun
methods.description: Executes pre-run setup for the base migration.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles different application stages, potentially triggering migration actions.

methods.name: handleApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles application events, such as sign-in, to trigger stage-specific migrations.

methods.name: hasPendingMigrations
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending migrations or keychain repairs needed.

methods.name: getStoredSnjsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the stored version of the application from persistent storage.

methods.name: getRequiredMigrations
methods.description: Determines which migration classes are required based on the stored version, sorting and comparing migration versions.

methods.name: instantiateMigrationClasses
methods.description: Creates instances of migration classes that need to be run.

methods.name: handleStage
methods.description: Handles application stage transitions and propagates them to active migrations.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about the migration service state.
